note: Decisions about how localization work reaches people outside this repository. Each one names who decided it, whether it is provisional, and what replaces it.

xliff.rationale: No native translator has been booked yet, so this answers in the direction that cannot strand the schedule. XLIFF 2.1 is what a professional translator or agency is most likely to ask for, and a tool built and unused costs the effort of deleting one code path. A tool discovered missing costs schedule at the point where bulk translation is already running, which is the one moment there is nothing to trade.
xliff.replacedBy: The booked native translator's own answer. See docs/design/07-globalization.md section 9.5 for what to change and what each answer obliges.
